name: runtime
description: The runtime linked into compiled Silver programs, built into build/runtime, and its libraries shipped in out/runtime for silverc to link.
preGenerateCommands-windows: (if not exist "$PACKAGE_DIR..\build\runtime" mkdir "$PACKAGE_DIR..\build\runtime") & for %I in ("$DC") do (xcopy /d /y /q "%~dpI..\lib64\phobos64.lib" "$PACKAGE_DIR..\build\runtime" >nul && xcopy /d /y /q /i "%~dpI..\lib64\mingw" "$PACKAGE_DIR..\build\runtime\mingw" >nul)
